title: M2S-Bench Protocol B cost-menu declaration
description: Schema for official and rescoring profiles. C_op is the frozen leaderboard profile; C_mem and C_lat are secondary materialization/latency rescoring profiles.

unit.description: Declared operation units, normalized bytes/footprint units, normalized p95 latency units, or custom units.

active_cost_field.description: Field used by the Protocol B scorer for this cost profile.

trace_cost_fields.description: Additional cost fields retained for lineage or secondary interpretation, not used unless explicitly copied into declared_cost.

units.description: Backward-compatible alias for unit. New cost menus should use unit.

scoring_rule.description: Utility/regret rule for this profile, normally U=A-lambda*C and R=max_v U(v)-U(route).
